resources.string: Keep one conversation and remember your time together

One character, one chat window
Once created, this character stays in the same conversation instead of opening another window.

Remember what matters
Single-session character memory organizes preferences, experiences, and promises. You can view, edit, and check them against the original messages. It is stored separately from ordinary character memory and global Agent memory.

Bring existing chats along
On the creation page, select an existing character, then the conversation to transfer. After configuring a model and converting the data, a new copy is created. The original character and chat are preserved.

Use tools when needed
You can still use configured, available Agent tools while chatting. Models and tools may incur provider charges.
